Nora K.: @Auditor_Anita quick Q: your evidence list asks for 'KMS access + RBAC change records (90d)'. Do you want raw CloudTrail or our curated evidence package?

Auditor_Anita: Curated package preferred. Need per-request: principal, key-id, action, result, plus rotation events and any failed auths. Also a control crosswalk to SOC2/ISO controls.

Sam T.: We can drop kms-requests.csv, rotations.json, rbac-audit.csv, approvals.zip, and an index.md that maps files to control IDs. ETA today EOD. Any formatting constraints (CSV headers)?

Auditor_Anita: CSV is fine. Header must include principal,keyid,action,result,timestamp. For RBAC include terraform plan output and git diffs for approvals.

Ezra (infra): Note: small collector gap on 2024-10-18 01:40-01:52 UTC in us-east-1 (INC-2024-470). Backfill completed; we'll include backfill.log and the incident ticket link.

Nora K.: Also attaching vuln triage: RBAC change came from mitigation for CVE-2024-0812 in dep Y. Will include PR link, rollout notes, and rollback plan.

Auditor_Anita: Add 3 redacted sample rows (principals redacted) for sampling and sign them. If any logs were restored from archive, annotate reason and approver.

Sam T.: Example redacted row we'll include: `principal:user:REDACTED, keyid:arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999900001111:key/aa11bb22, action:Decrypt, timestamp:2024-09-21T14:12:05Z, result:Allowed`.

InfraBot: INC-2024-470 backfill completed by ezra at 2024-10-18T09:05:12Z  artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1769994444/backfill.log :white_check_mark:

Nora K.: I'll assemble index.md with control crosswalk (SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9) and brief rationales. Uploading artifacts in ~40m and will post S3 path.

Auditor_Anita: Thanks team, ping me if anything changes — will validate once downloaded.
